# weka_filesystem_group (Data Source)

Look up an existing filesystem group by UID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "weka_filesystem_group" "tiered" {
  name = "tiered"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Filesystem group UID. Exactly one of id or name is required.
- `name` (String) Filesystem group name. Exactly one of id or name is required.

### Read-Only

- `start_demote` (Number) Seconds after a write before data is copied to the object store.
- `target_ssd_retention` (Number) Seconds data is kept on SSD before it is released to the object store.
